title: "What do you know about me?", then "forget that"
origin: Spec #8 (coach memory), part 2: honest short answer; forget removes it and confirms in one line

history.text: Sam! 15 minutes of push-ups and squats at home at 6.

plan.proof_note: a quick voice note of what you did
plan.reason: Fifteen minutes right after work, before the couch wins.

facts.text: Works at a bank; says he hates his job there
Has a dog, Max, who joins him for walks
Hates mornings; does better after work
Texts short, swears a bit, says lol
Voice notes over photos: 'photos are a pain'
Goes on walks with Sam most evenings

daily.title: Done after work
daily.body: Voice note: did push-ups and squats.

testerLines: wait what do you even know about me lol
ok forget the stuff about my job
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: asking what ZOH knows, then asking it to forget something.
shouldHaveHappened: First answer: a short honest summary of what's in memory (the bank job he hates, his dog Max, hating mornings, voice notes over photos), a few lines at most, no invented details, then a light check that it's right. After 'forget the stuff about my job': a one-line confirmation, and the job fact is gone from memory. Second answer: the same kind of summary without anything about his job.
